title: 第2532章 相互博弈第2531章 陆宸准备去神武大陆
content_zh:
从大本营出来，陆宸没有直接去神武大陆，而是先乘坐传送阵来到了北天庭。
经过之前那么一通扫荡，北天庭统治疆域的魔族损失惨重，一下子没了嚣张气焰。
如今魔族和一众老东西又集中在风神族的地盘上，北天庭统治疆域现在和平了许多。
当恢复陆无命容貌的陆宸来到北天庭时，混元大帝和北冥大帝一起出来相迎。
因为没有大战，两人的状态都陆宸比上一次刚来时更好，脸上也多了不少的笑容。
陆宸没有和两人过多的寒喧，直接带着两人来到修行密室，又将两人带进生机方印。
在这里，陆宸一次次的从北冥大帝身上抽取两种诅咒，再将两种诅咒之力逼出来。
外界过了将近一天，北冥大帝体内残余的所有诅咒之力都被陆宸抽走，并收集了起来。
一为北冥大帝清除两种诅咒，陆宸又让北冥大帝帮自己收集之前用完的废石。
两人不明白陆宸为什么要收集废石，但也没有多问，随口就答应了陆宸的请求。
之后，陆宸离开北天庭，一路南下，来到南天庭，又出手帮金乌大帝清除诅咒。
出来的第三天傍晚，陆宸清除了金乌大帝体内的诅咒，又乘坐传送阵往北走。
不到一个时辰，陆宸来到南天庭当下依旧掌控的边大陆，开始乘坐空间战船北上。
此后，陆宸像之前那样，途经大陆就疯狂对付魔族、魔修、魔兽和魔虫，并尽可能的救一些本土生灵，放在世界里。
而一到海域，陆宸进入空间天书世界和混沌珠世界，继续修行自己的人皇经。
如此过了二十多天，陆宸横跨七座大陆，终于是从南天庭统治疆域进了中天庭统治疆域。
进入中天庭统治疆域后，陆宸发现就像鼠爷他们说的那样，魔族、魔兽和魔虫明显减少。
而且，魔族不怎么进攻，只是双方对峙。
在这种情况下，陆宸发现大量的生灵从南天庭原来的统治边大陆涌入中央天庭统治疆域。
让人痛心的是，这些自以为中央天庭统治疆域安全，费尽千辛万苦逃进中央天庭统治疆域的生灵又被魔族和中央天庭的人分了。

是了，就是被分了！
通过搜魂，陆宸得知人一进边大陆，魔族就派人抓捕，弱者归魔族，成为魔族食粮和繁衍魔胎的工具，强者则是放过去，算是送给中央天庭，达成共分生灵的默契。
而在中央天庭和魔族无声的瓜分下，每天都有大量生灵死于非命，魔族也趁机繁衍了大量魔胎，魔胎数量多得吓人。
陆宸没有客气，直接动手扫荡魔族族、魔兽、魔虫和魔修，并拯救被抓的人。
如此几天下来，魔族和中央天庭的人都发现了南疆的异常，并猜到是陆宸做的。
而之所以一下就猜到了，原因就是猪皇他们这些有神器的人都还被牵制在了风神族。
双方没有联络，但都有了动作。
之后，灵神族对外放出消息，说是灵神族平定了陆宸收拾的那些大陆的魔族，大陆安全通道已经打开，大家可以通过这些大陆进入中央天庭统治的安全大陆。
与此同时，灵神族和魔族都派出强者赶往陆宸可能去的大陆，试图猎杀陆宸。
content_en:
After coming out of the base camp, Lu Chen did not go directly to Shenwu Continent, but first took the teleportation array to Beitianting.
After the previous sweep, the demons in the territory ruled by Beitianting suffered heavy losses and suddenly lost their arrogance.
Now that the demon clan and a group of old people are concentrated on the territory of the Wind God clan, the territory ruled by the North Heaven Court is now much peaceful.
When Lu Chen, who had restored Lu Wuming's appearance, came to Beitianting, Emperor Hunyuan and Emperor Beiming came out to greet him.
Because there was no big battle, both of them were in better condition than when they arrived last time, and there were many more smiles on their faces.
Lu Chen did not exchange too many greetings with the two of them, and directly took them to the secret practice room, and then brought them into the vitality square seal.
Here, Lu Chen extracted two curses from Emperor Beiming again and again, and then forced out the power of the two curses.
After nearly a day in the outside world, all the remaining curse power in Emperor Beiming's body was drained away by Lu Chen and collected.
Once he cleared two curses for Emperor Beiming, Lu Chen asked Emperor Beiming to help him collect the waste rocks that he had used up before.
The two of them didn't understand why Lu Chen wanted to collect waste rocks, but they didn't ask any more questions and casually agreed to Lu Chen's request.
After that, Lu Chen left the North Heaven Court and went all the way south to the South Heaven Court, where he helped Emperor Golden Crow remove the curse.
On the evening of the third day after coming out, Lu Chen cleared the curse from the body of the Golden Crow Emperor and took the teleportation array to the north.
In less than an hour, Lu Chen arrived at the border continent that Nan Tianting still controlled, and began to take the space warship to the north.
After that, Lu Chen went through the mainland like before and frantically dealt with demons, demon cultivators, demonic beasts and demonic insects, and tried to save as many local creatures as possible and put them in the world.
As soon as he arrived at the sea, Lu Chen entered the Space Book World and the Chaos Pearl World to continue practicing his Human Emperor Sutra.
After more than twenty days like this, Lu Chen traveled across seven continents and finally entered the territory ruled by the South Heavenly Court.
After entering the territory ruled by Zhongtian Court, Lu Chen found that just as Master Shu and others said, the demon clan, magical beasts and magical insects had significantly decreased.
Moreover, the demons don't attack very much, they just confront each other.
Under this situation, Lu Chen discovered that a large number of creatures poured into the Central Heavenly Court's territory from the continent on the edge of the South Heavenly Court's original rule.
What is sad is that these creatures who thought that the territory ruled by the Central Heaven was safe and went through all the trouble to escape into the territory ruled by the Central Heaven were divided between the demons and the people of the Central Heaven.
Yes, they were divided!
Through soul searching, Lu Chen learned that as soon as people entered the border continent, the demon clan would send people to arrest them. The weak ones would be returned to the demon clan to become the demon clan's food and a tool for multiplying demon fetuses.
Under the silent carve-up between the Central Heaven and the Demon Clan, a large number of creatures died every day. The Demon Clan also took the opportunity to reproduce a large number of demon fetuses, and the number of demon fetuses was frightening.
Lu Chen was not polite and went straight to sweep away the demons, monsters, insects and cultivators, and rescued those who were caught.
After a few days, the demon clan and the people in the Central Heavenly Court discovered the anomaly in Southern Xinjiang and guessed that it was Lu Chen who did it.
And the reason why he guessed it right away is that people like the Pig King and others who have artifacts are still restrained by the Wind God Clan.
There was no contact between the two parties, but they both took action.
Afterwards, the Lingshen Clan released news to the outside world, saying that the Lingshen Clan had pacified the demon clans on the mainland that Lu Chen had dealt with, and that safe passages to the mainland had been opened, and everyone could enter the safe continent ruled by the Central Heavenly Court through these continents.
At the same time, both the Spirit God Clan and the Demon Clan sent strong men to the continent where Lu Chen might go, trying to hunt down Lu Chen.
